title: Every CrewAI autolog span write must go through _set_sanitized_attribute and the credential key filter
answers: How do I add a new CrewAI attribute to a trace without leaking secrets?
Where should CrewAI span attribute sanitization happen?
Which keys are dropped from CrewAI autolog spans?
body:
Invariant: every attribute written in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_span_attributes goes through mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_sanitized_attribute, not span.set_attribute directly; calling set_attribute with a raw object skips the guard and can leak an api_key.
_set_sanitized_attribute returns early when the key itself matches _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN, because a field such as auth_token holds a plain string that _sanitize_value cannot recognize as a credential.
_SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN drops api_key, secret, password, authorization and credential anywhere in the name, and token only as a snake_case suffix or camelCase Token suffix. max_tokens, tokenizer and token_usage are kept.
_get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes and _get_llm_attributes apply the same key filter; _get_llm_attributes skips callbacks explicitly.
What breaks if skipped: a credential reaches mlflow.spanAttributes or mlflow.spanInputs in the trace JSON.
applies: Any new or edited span attribute, span input, or LLM/Agent/Task/Crew field handling in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py.
says: Private API keys and passwords are visible inside agent run trace details.
Sanitize authentication tokens before recording agent and task execution traces.
Secret credentials leaked into the exported trace view for multi-agent workflows.
Mask authorization secrets while keeping usage token counts in trace logs.
search: Span attribute writes in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_span_attributes must call _set_sanitized_attribute to prevent leaking credentials into trace attributes or inputs. The _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN filter drops keys containing api_key, secret, password, authorization, or credential anywhere in the name, and token only as a snake_case suffix or camelCase Token suffix, while preserving max_tokens, tokenizer, and token_usage. The key filter applies to _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes, and _get_llm_attributes, with callbacks skipped explicitly in _get_llm_attributes. Calling span.set_attribute directly with raw objects bypasses sanitization and leaks sensitive credentials into mlflow.spanAttributes or mlflow.spanInputs.
